memory.summary:
On December 29th at 3 PM, Andy and Noor meet at the gym to discuss the AI music project, and they later schedule a meeting with Samantha and others at the museum on December 30th at 4 PM. Both meetings are added to their schedules, and they look forward to a productive week ahead. During the day, Andy also meets Diego at the town hall around 3 PM, where he brings vegan street tacos to celebrate their collaboration. They discuss new melodies for the AI project and plan to continue their discussion at Caroline's Café the next day at 3 PM. Diego encourages Andy to stretch before their meeting.

On the same day at 9 PM, Andy also talks to Peter at the museum. Peter agrees to discuss ideas for the AI music project at Andy's place the next day at 2 PM. Peter also brings seeds for the community garden. Both meetings contribute to a more collaborative week ahead for the AI music project.
